- 2026-09-14T16:37:03.026Z — chose **Fixture providers mirror REAL provider API shapes. They never hand the app a solution to a planted decision:
- Amounts are decimal strings in the point-of-sale currency. International fares are priced in the origin market's currency; domestic fares and hotels in local currency (JPY "18000", JOD "85.500", VND "1250000").
- Fare search with no cabin returns ALL cabins.
- Hotels mix taxes-included and taxes-extra rates.
- No minor-unit metadata anywhere.
- Cities carry IANA time zones, as real geo APIs do.
- FX rates are decimal strings.
Data is generated deterministically: seeded by route, date and city, never random.** over App-friendly fixtures: prices as integer minor units already in home currency, fare search pre-filtered to one cabin, tax-normalised nightly rates, a minorUnits field per currency. because Spec §5's planted decisions test whether an arm REMEMBERS a choice the operator made: money in minor units, one FX path, cabin as a standing preference, per-night budget including taxes. Fixtures that pre-normalise these would make every arm pass by construction, and C3/C5 would measure nothing. Real-API shapes also keep the D1 product path to live providers an adapter swap.
